Hi,
I live in the subdivision in Players Walk Holly Hills in Ijamsville. The road Ritchie Drive is a speed violation road. I currently only see one sign ( near the Holly Hills Club) turning on Ritchie from Mussetter that is posted at 25 mph. 
Car speeds on that road are extremely fast and whip around the curve.  I pass cars coming home. I am concern for public and wildlife safety. I would guess speeds up to 50 mph plus. Also, residents do walk the sides of the road. If possible, could you post more 25 mph signs or put a speed monitor to collect data.  I believe the one sign is not sufficient. 
Also, outside of Ritchie and Musseter/Ijamsville Road the bushes are overgrowing where the cars that quickly come down Ijamsville Road are not seen if you are looking to turn left. Sorry for two requests. The first one is more important.

Thanks,
Michelle

issues.description:
Hello! For over a month now there has been roadwork on old Middletown road that the residents who live in this location were never informed about. Several of us have driveways that are blocked or obstructed by the daily work that are the ONLY entrance/exit points to getting into our homes. There have been several days where I’ve had to wait 10 minutes to simply pull into or get out of my driveway, adding extra delays into my morning, causing disruption to my childcare and work schedule. Additionally, signs have been posted directly up against my house, putting pressure on my fence that has now begun to lean, and blocking me from being able to mow along the side of my house. My vehicle is taking a hit due to having to go over large bumps and about a 2 inch gap from the bottom of my driveway onto the road. This morning the paving vehicle fully went up against/onto the sidewalk on the side of my house, causing my entire home to shake and further damage to my fencing losing stability. This morning I was also alarmed by the sound of banging against the side of my house, realizing that workers were leaning equipment against my house. 

While I understand that roadwork needs to happen and that the workers are simply doing their jobs, this is also incredibly frustrating. Looking for more clarity and transparency on the timeline of this road work and what can be done about my grass and fencing.
